Item was in such good condition that I would have believed it was new.  Installed the motheboard, and it seems to be working perfectly.

ASUS Pro ws x570 ace. Beautifully packaged. Great condition. Arrived in only 10 days. It has been running for a week now. Works perfect. I’m very happy with the purchase. These people did a great job. I highly recommend them. It was a positive review that led me to do business with them. Hope this helps someone else.

Lightning-fast shipping and item arrived exactly as described. Excellent communication, secure packaging, and pristine item. Highly recommended transaction. The items arrived ahead of schedule and works perfectly. Thanks!

My only gripe is the price was higher than most other sellers, and fedex charged an import fee due to shipping into the states despite being listed as free shipping. 4/5, would probably use this seller again.
Excellent packaging and item as described. A+ seller!

The RTX 4080 32GB cards arrived in excellent condition and worked right out of the box. The packaging was very secure. Shipping was fast, arriving earlier than the original estimate. The vendor kept me updated on the status through the entire process.

Excellent. A bit disappointed that the price dropped after I bought. Should have negotiated! But very professional and responsive seller. Fast shipping. Packaging excellent.
